summary: This clinical trial will test a drug called eloralintide in adults who have obesity or are overweight, have type 2 diabetes, and face an increased risk of heart and blood vessel problems. Eli Lilly and Company is sponsoring this Phase 3 study, which aims to enroll 3000 participants. The status is currently Not yet recruiting. Participants will receive either eloralintide or a placebo, which is an inactive substance that looks like the drug.
